reference.configuration: Original Lagrange-class submarine profile in the 1918 diesel-powered configuration: low long casing, compact central conning tower, two single 75 mm deck guns and no steam funnels. The eight torpedo tubes include internal/beam installations that are not exposed as deck launchers. The earlier steam concept is not depicted.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
